text:
leo: FYI - new hire on mac ran into a weird onboarding snag. Downloaded the tar.gz from Releases, double-clicked the binary in Finder, completed browser auth, but `redwoodctl whoami` returns unauthenticated.
mai: what does `redwoodctl profiles list --json` show?
leo: shows default -> /Users/leo/.redwood and default-quarantine -> /private/var/folders/.../com.apple.quarantine/rwd-abc. Token was written to the quarantine path.
nirav: ah, mac quarantine xattr (com.apple.quarantine) moves/exposes a quarantined execution path under /private/var/folders during Finder exec. That makes our installer fallback pick a local config next to the running binary.
sam: can you paste `xattr -l /path/to/redwoodctl` and `spctl -a -v /path/to/redwoodctl`? Finder double-click often triggers quarantine.
leo: output (redacted): `xattr -l redwoodctl: com.apple.quarantine: 0081;5f...` and `spctl: accepted, source=Notarized Developer ID`.
liz: mitigation: print a specific startup banner when binary path includes `/private/var/folders` or when `xattr` contains com.apple.quarantine. Banner: "It looks like redwoodctl was opened from Finder and is running from a quarantined path. Move the binary to /usr/local/bin or remove the quarantine attribute to avoid losing login state."
carla: docs: Quickstart should explicitly call out Finder double-click caveat for mac tarballs and advise Homebrew cask or `mv redwoodctl /usr/local/bin` before login. Add a troubleshooting step: check `xattr -l` and run `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /usr/local/bin/redwoodctl` if they trust the binary.
nirav: plan: (1) detect quarantined execution and emit telemetry event `installer.mac_quarantine_profile`, (2) print banner with migrate hint, (3) add `redwoodctl doctor` to show binary path + profile path and a one-line fix.
sam: add QA: reproduce by downloading via Safari, double-clicking (which triggers quarantine) and confirm profile ends up under /private/var; then run `redwoodctl migrate --from <quarantine-path> --to default` to validate recovery.
support-bot: ticket DX-13021 created with reproduction steps and recommended commands.
leo: small UX ask: when login finishes and we detect token in quarantine profile, show an inline prompt: "Migrate token to your persistent profile now? (Y/n)" so non-technical users recover immediately.
nirav: agree, interactive prompt for GUI-initiated flows is ok; noninteractive sessions will default to persistent profile. ETA: banner + doctor EOD, migrate CLI + tests early next week.
carla: thanks team 44d. This saved a new hire from lots of confusion.
